assertions.assertion: The claim is for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring
The CPT code for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring is 93229
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has a recent history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmic etiologies
The arrhythmic etiologies contribute to neurological and vestibular symptoms
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-197
The denial was based on missing prior authorization
The service is required to assess the arrhythmic causes of the patient's documented neurological and vestibular symptoms
